paragraphs: Headquartered in Austin, Texas, YETI is a global designer, retailer, and distributor of innovative outdoor products. From coolers and drinkware to bags and apparel, YETI products are built to meet the unique and varying needs of diverse outdoor pursuits, whether in the remote wilderness, at the beach, or anywhere life takes you. By consistently delivering high-performing, exceptional products, we have built a strong following of brand loyalists throughout the world, ranging from serious outdoor enthusiasts to individuals who simply value products of uncompromising quality and design. We have an unwavering commitment to outdoor and recreation communities, and we are relentless in our pursuit of building superior products for people to confidently enjoy life outdoors and beyond.

We were founded in 2006 by avid outdoorsmen, Roy and Ryan Seiders, who were frustrated with equipment that could not keep pace with their interests in hunting and fishing. By utilizing forward-thinking designs and advanced manufacturing techniques, they developed a nearly indestructible hard cooler with superior ice retention. Our original hard cooler not only delivered exceptional performance, it anchored an authentic, passionate, and durable bond among customers and our company.

Our principal corporate offices are located in Austin, Texas. Unless the context requires otherwise, references to "YETI," the "Company," "we," "us," and "our" used herein refer to YETI Holdings, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

We have a 52- or 53-week fiscal year that ends on the Saturday closest in proximity to December 31, such that each quarterly period will be 13 weeks in length, except during a 53-week year when the fourth quarter will be 14 weeks. Our fiscal year ended January 3, 2026 ("2025") was 53 weeks. Our fiscal years ended December 28, 2024 ("2024") and December 30, 2023 ("2023") were 52 weeks each. Unless otherwise stated, references to particular years, quarters, months and periods refer to our fiscal years ended in December and the associated quarters, months, and periods of those fiscal years.

Our product portfolio consists of three categories: Coolers & Equipment; Drinkware; and Other. We have a history of consistently broadening our high-performance, premium-priced product portfolio to meet our expanding customer base and their evolving pursuits. Our culture of innovation and success in identifying customer needs and wants drives our robust product roadmap. In 2025, net sales of Coolers & Equipment, Drinkware, and Other represented 40%, 58%, and 2% of net sales, respectively. Refer to Note 3 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for net sales by product category.
Our Coolers & Equipment category consists of seven platforms: hard coolers, soft cooler bags, everyday bags, travel bags, pursuit bags, cargo and storage, and outdoor living.

Hard Coolers. Our hard coolers are built with seamless rotomolded construction or injection molding construction, making them nearly indestructible. For superior ice retention, we pressure-inject up to two inches of commercial-grade polyurethane foam into the walls and lid and utilize a freezer-quality gasket to seal the lid. In 2025, we introduced the redesigned Roadie 24 within our Roadie cooler family. Our hard cooler platform includes the YETI Tundra, YETI Roadie, YETI V Series hard coolers, YETI TANK ice bucket, and YETI Silo 6G water cooler. Related accessories include locks, dry baskets, beverage holders, and dividers.

Soft Cooler Bags. Our soft cooler bags platform consists of our Hopper Collection and Daytrip Collection of soft cooler bags. The Hopper Collection is our line of soft cooler bags designed to be leakproof and provide superior durability and ice retention compared to ordinary soft cooler bags. The Hopper Collection includes the M15 Soft Cooler, M12 Soft Backpack Cooler, M30 Soft Cooler, M20 Backpack Cooler, and the Flip Soft Cooler. The Daytrip Collection is built for all-day use and consists of ultra-portable insulated soft cooler bags. In 2025, we expanded our Daytrip Collection with the launch of the Lunchboxes in two sizes, Lunch Bag, and Tote Bag.

Bags. Our bags offerings span three platforms covering everyday, travel, and pursuit bags. These offerings include the Panga Collection of waterproof duffel bags and backpacks, Crossroads Collection of backpacks, duffel bags, luggage, and packing cubes, Camino Carryall, and SideKick Dry gear case. In 2025, we expanded our bags offerings with the new Cayo Collection of all-weather backpacks in three sizes and Ranchero Collection of backpacks in four sizes.

Cargo and Storage. We offer a range of cargo and storage solutions including: the LoadOut GoBox in multiple sizes, LoadOut Bucket, and LoadOut Swivel Seat. In 2025, we also expanded our cargo offerings with the smaller format LoadOut GoBox.

Outdoor Living. Our outdoor living platform includes the Trailhead Camp Chair, Lowlands Blanket, and Boomer Dog Bowls. In 2025, we also expanded our outdoor living offerings with the new Hondo Beach Chair, a limited release of the Can Crusher, and the YETI Fire Pit.

Our Drinkware category consists of four platforms: bottles and jugs, cups, mugs, and tumblers, tableware, coffeeware, barware, and containers, and cookware. Most of our Drinkware products are made with durable, kitchen-grade, 18/8 stainless-steel, double-wall vacuum insulation, and our innovative No Sweat design. The result is high-performing drinkware products that keep beverages at their preferred temperature—whether hot or cold—for hours at a time without condensation.

Bottles and Jugs. Our bottles and jugs platform includes the Rambler Collection of bottles and jugs, Yonder Collection of water bottles and shaker bottles, and Silo Collection of jugs. In 2025, we expanded this platform with the launch of the Rambler Travel Bottle in three sizes, Yonder Shaker Bottle in two sizes, Silo Jug with Straw Cap in two sizes, Silo Jug with Chug Cap, and introduced the redesigned Rambler Jug in two sizes.

Cups, Mugs, and Tumblers. Our cups, mugs, and tumblers platform includes the Rambler Collection of Stackable Pints, Mugs, Tumblers, and Cups. In 2025, we expanded this platform with the launch of the Rambler Travel Straw Mug in three sizes and Rambler Junior Tumbler with Silicone Straw.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry
If we are unable to successfully design, develop and market new products, our business may be harmed.
Our business could be materially harmed if we are unable to accurately forecast our growth rate and demand for our products.
We may not be able to effectively manage our growth.
Our growth depends, in part, on expanding into additional consumer markets, and we may not be successful in doing so.
Our future success depends on the continuing efforts of our management and key employees and on our ability to attract and retain highly skilled personnel and senior management.
We may be subject to liability if we infringe upon the intellectual property rights of third parties.
We rely on third-party contract manufacturers, and problems with, or loss of, our suppliers or an inability to obtain raw materials could harm our business and results of operations.

If we fail to timely and effectively obtain shipments of products from our manufacturers and deliver products to our retail partners and customers, our business and results of operations could be harmed.
Our business is subject to the risk of manufacturer concentrations.
Our business could be harmed if we fail to execute our plans to continue expanding our supply chain, technology and certain other business processes to a large global scale.
If we cannot maintain prices or effectively implement price increases, our margins may decrease.
Fluctuations in the cost and availability of raw materials, equipment, labor, and transportation could cause manufacturing delays or increase our costs.

Adverse changes in international trade policies, tariffs and treaties, including increases in tariff rates and the imposition of additional tariffs, may materially adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Our aspirations, disclosures, and actions related to sustainability matters expose us to risks that could adversely affect our reputation and performance.
Climate change, and related legislative and regulatory responses to climate change, may adversely impact our business.
If we do not successfully navigate risks associated with, or realize sufficient return on investments in, our DTC channel, our business and results of operations could be harmed.
Insolvency, credit problems or other financial difficulties that could confront our retail partners could expose us to financial risk.

If our independent suppliers and manufacturing partners do not comply with ethical business practices or with applicable laws and regulations, our reputation, business, and results of operations could be harmed.

We are subject to payment-related risks that may result in higher operating costs or the inability to process payments, either of which could harm our business, financial condition and results of operations.
paragraphs: Our business, financial condition and operating results can be affected by a number of risks and uncertainties, whether currently known or unknown, any one or more of which could, directly or indirectly, cause our actual results of operations and financial condition to vary materially from past, or from anticipated future, results of operations and financial condition. The risks discussed below are not the only ones facing our business but do represent those risks that we believe are material to us. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Our business depends on maintaining and strengthening our brand to attract new customers and generating and maintaining ongoing demand for our products, and a significant reduction in such demand could harm our results of operations.

The YETI name and premium brand image are integral to the growth of our business, as well as to the implementation of our strategies for expanding our business. Our success depends on the value and reputation of our brand, which is rooted in passion for the outdoors. To sustain long-term growth, we must continue to successfully promote our products to consumers who align with the values of our brand, as well as to individuals who simply value products of uncompromising quality and design. Our ability to execute our marketing and growth strategy depends on many factors, such as the quality, design, performance, functionality, and durability of our products; the image and reputation of our e-commerce platform; the design of our retail floor spaces and our wholesale partners' floor spaces; the impact of our communication activities, including advertising, social media, and public relations; and our management of the customer experience, including direct interfaces through customer service. Maintaining, promoting, and positioning our brand are important to expanding our customer base and will depend largely on the success of our marketing and merchandising efforts and our ability to provide consistent, high-quality customer experiences.

We have made, and we expect that we will continue to make, significant investments in promoting our products and attracting new customers, including through the use of corporate and sports league partnerships, YETI Ambassadors, traditional, digital, and social media, original YETI films, and participation in, and sponsorship of, community events. Marketing campaigns can be expensive and may not result in the cost-effective acquisition of customers. Ineffective marketing, ongoing and sustained promotional activities, negative publicity, product diversion to unauthorized distribution channels, product or manufacturing defects, product recalls, counterfeit products, unfair labor practices, and failure to protect the intellectual property rights in our brand are some of the potential threats to the strength of our brand, and those and other factors could rapidly and severely diminish customer confidence in us. Furthermore, these factors could cause our customers to lose the personal connection they feel with the YETI brand. The rapid diffusion of information through social media also heightens the risk that negative publicity—whether accurate or not—regarding product performance, Ambassador conduct, company policies or sourcing practices could quickly erode brand equity. Actions by individuals or organizations associated with YETI (including Ambassadors and influencers) that are inconsistent with our brand values, whether on our platforms or theirs, could also harm our brand reputation and materially impact our business. Further, now that our brand is more widely known in our established markets, future marketing campaigns may not attract new customers at the same rate as past campaigns. Inflation, higher product costs or other macroeconomic factors may also affect our ability to provide products in a cost-effective manner and hinder us from attracting new customers. If we are unable to attract new customers, fail to attract new customers in a cost-effective manner, or fail to drive awareness of our full product portfolio among new and existing customers, our growth could be slower than we expect, and our business could be harmed.

The market for our products is characterized by new product introductions, frequent enhancements, customization options, new colorways for existing products, and changing customer demands, needs and preferences. This is emphasized by the fact that our products are high-quality, durable, and do not have a natural replacement cycle. Shorter innovation cycles and the growing influence of social-media reviews further increase the risk that new products will not achieve anticipated acceptance or that our intellectual-property safeguards will be circumvented. To maintain and increase sales, we must continue to introduce new products and improve or enhance our existing products on a timely basis to respond to new and evolving consumer preferences. The success of our new and enhanced products depends on many factors, including anticipating consumer preferences, finding innovative solutions to consumer problems, differentiating our products from those of our competitors, maintaining the strength of our brand, onboarding new manufacturing processes and suppliers, and successful product lifecycle management. The design and development of our products is costly, and we typically have several products in development at the same time. Design or quality issues, or delays in launching new products, could damage our brand, disrupt our business, and negatively affect our financial condition and results of operations. Any new products that we develop and market may not generate sufficient revenues to recoup their development, production, marketing, selling and other costs.

To ensure adequate inventory supply, we must forecast inventory needs and place orders with our manufacturers before firm orders are placed by our customers. Forecasts are particularly challenging as we expand into new markets and geographies, develop and market new products, and face macroeconomic uncertainties, including related to consumer discretionary spending, interest rates, inflation, tariffs and geopolitical events. Our historical sales, expense levels, and profitability may not be an appropriate basis for forecasting future results. If we fail to accurately forecast customer demand, including relating to our expected growth, we may experience excess inventory levels or a shortage of products to deliver to our customers. Failure to accurately forecast our results of operations and growth rate could also cause us to make poor operating decisions, and we may not be able to adjust in a timely manner. Consequently, actual results could be materially lower than anticipated. Even if the markets in which we compete expand, we cannot assure you that our business will grow at similar rates, or at all.

paragraphs: Headquartered in Austin, Texas, YETI is a global designer, retailer, and distributor of innovative outdoor products. From coolers and drinkware to bags and apparel, YETI products are built to meet the unique and varying needs of diverse outdoor pursuits, whether in the remote wilderness, at the beach, or anywhere life takes you. By consistently delivering high-performing, exceptional products, we have built a strong following of brand loyalists throughout the world, ranging from serious outdoor enthusiasts to individuals who simply value products of uncompromising quality and design. We have an unwavering commitment to outdoor and recreation communities, and we are relentless in our pursuit of building superior products for people to confidently enjoy life outdoors and beyond.

We distribute our products through a balanced omni-channel platform, consisting of our wholesale and direct-to-consumer ("DTC") channels. In our wholesale channel, we sell our products through select national and regional accounts and an assemblage of independent retail partners throughout the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Europe, and Japan, among others. We carefully evaluate and select retail partners that have an image and approach that are consistent with our premium brand and pricing. Our national and regional specialty retailers in the United States include Dick's Sporting Goods, REI, Academy Sports + Outdoors, Bass Pro Shops, Ace Hardware, Scheels, and Tractor Supply Company. In our international regions, our notable retailers include FGL Sports and SportChek in Canada, BCF and Rebel in Australia, and GO Outdoors in the United Kingdom. We sell our products in our DTC channel to customers on our websites, through YETI Authorized on the Amazon Marketplace, as well as in our retail stores. Additionally, we offer customized products with licensed marks and original artwork primarily to our DTC channel, through our corporate sales program, on our websites, and at select retail stores, as well as certain wholesale partners. Our corporate sales program offers customized products to corporate customers for a wide-range of events and activities, and in certain instances may also offer products to re-sell.

During the first quarter of 2025, we expanded our bag offerings with the launch of the new Ranchero backpack in two sizes and introduced new seasonal colorways across our Drinkware and Coolers & Equipment categories.

During the second quarter of 2025, we expanded our bottles and jugs offerings with the launch of the new Rambler Travel Bottle in two sizes and introduced the redesigned and improved Rambler Jug in two sizes. We continued the expansion of our tableware offerings with the launch of the new Rambler Insulated Bowls in six sizes and expanded our cookware offerings with the launch of a new size of the Cast Iron Skillet. In our Coolers & Equipment category, we expanded our hard cooler offerings with the redesigned Roadie 24, and expanded our outdoor living offerings with the launch of the new Hondo Beach Chair and a limited release of the Can Crusher. We continued the expansion of our bag offerings with the launch of the new Cayo backpack in two sizes and two new sizes of the Ranchero backpack. In our soft cooler bags offerings, we expanded the Daytrip Collection with the launch of the launch of the new Daytrip Lunchboxes in two sizes, the Daytrip Lunch Bag, and the Daytrip Tote Bag. We also introduced new seasonal colorways across our Drinkware and Coolers & Equipment categories.

During the third quarter of 2025, we expanded our coffeeware offerings with the launch of the Rambler Ceramic Mug Collection in two sizes, and introduced a new size of the Rambler Travel Bottle within our bottles offerings. We continued the expansion of our container offerings with the launch of the new Rambler Food Jars in two sizes. In our Coolers & Equipment category, we expanded our bags offerings with the introduction of a new size of the Cayo backpack. We also introduced new seasonal colorways across our Drinkware and Coolers & Equipment categories.

During the fourth quarter of 2025, we expanded our bottles and jugs offerings with the launch of the Yonder Shaker Bottle in two sizes, the Silo Jug with Straw Cap in two sizes, and the Silo Jug with Chug Cap. We continued expansion of our mugs and tumbler offerings with the launch of the Rambler Travel Straw Mug in three sizes, the Rambler Junior Tumbler with Silicone Straw, and we introduced a new size of the Rambler Ceramic Stackable Cup within our coffeeware offerings. We also introduced a new size of the Rambler Food Jar within our containers offerings. We continued the expansion of our cookware offerings with the launch of the new Cast Iron Ranch Pan and a limited release of the new Carbon Steel Pan. In our Coolers & Equipment category, we expanded our outdoor living and cargo offerings with the introduction of the YETI Fire Pit and a smaller format LoadOut GoBox.

During the third quarter of 2025, we acquired certain assets, including designs, tooling, and intellectual property, related to the Helimix branded shaker bottle for $38.0 million in cash ("Helimix Acquisition"). During the fourth quarter of 2025, we showcased our speed-to-market with the launch of our Yonder Shaker Bottle, further advancing YETI's expansion into the sport, health and wellness categories. This product launch was made possible, in part, by the Helimix Acquisition.

Our business is exposed to and impacted by macroeconomic factors, including but not limited to uncertainty surrounding inflationary pressures, consumer confidence and purchasing behaviors, foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations, geopolitical conflicts, and government actions and policies, including changes in interest rates, tax rates, and tariff rates. We experienced a challenging macroeconomic and consumer spending environment in 2025 that adversely impacted our results of operations. The impact of such conditions on us for 2026 remains uncertain.

During 2025, the U.S. government implemented incremental tariffs on imports from many countries. Most of our products are produced in countries that were subject to these tariffs. As a result, the cost to import our products into the United States increased. During 2025, we pursued a number of strategic options to mitigate the impact of tariffs. For example, in response to the elevated tariffs on imports from China announced in early 2025, we accelerated the diversification of our Drinkware manufacturing to additional countries beyond China. As a result, a majority of our Drinkware manufacturing capacity is now outside of China. However, these accelerated diversification efforts caused short-term supply chain disruptions in 2025, which impacted our ability to source certain products. These disruptions caused inventory constraints that adversely impacted sales in 2025.

On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court invalidated tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Power Act (the "IEEPA Decision"). There remains significant uncertainty regarding the implementation of the IEEPA Decision, including the processes that will govern refund claims, the timing of any potential refunds, and the ultimate amounts, if any, that we may recover. In addition, immediately following the IEEPA Decision, the U.S. government initiated new tariffs under alternative authorities, resulting in continued tariff exposure for many of our products. There remains significant uncertainty regarding the duration and scope of these newly initiated tariffs, whether the U.S. government will pursue additional trade actions or impose further tariffs, and the impact of such conditions on our business. Similar to our strategy in 2025, we will strive to mitigate the impact of tariffs by managing operating expenses, working capital and cash; negotiating with suppliers; evaluating pricing strategies; leveraging tariff exemptions where possible; and pursuing other supply chain optimization activities. However, the ultimate impact of tariffs on our business and results of operations in 2026 remains uncertain.

paragraphs: 本公司總部設於德州奧斯汀，為一家全球知名的戶外產品設計、零售商與經銷商，專門提供創新性的戶外用品。從保冷箱與飲料容器，到揹包與服飾，本公司產品皆為因應多樣化的戶外活動需求而設計，無論是在偏遠的荒野、海灘，或任何生活場景皆可使用。透過持續提供高表現、卓越的產品，我們已在全球建立起忠實的品牌忠誠客戶羣，從專業戶外愛好者到僅僅重視產品品質與設計的消費者皆有包含在內。我們對戶外與休閒社羣抱持不渝的承諾，並持續追求打造更優質的產品，讓消費者能安心享受戶外與超越戶外的生活。
本公司於2006年由熱愛戶外活動的Roy與Ryan Seiders所創立，他們對市面上無法配合其狩獵與釣魚興趣的裝備感到不滿。透過前瞻性設計與先進製造技術，他們開發出幾乎無法摧毀的硬質保冷箱，並擁有優異的保冷效果。我們最初的硬質保冷箱不僅表現卓越，更建立起與客戶之間真實、熱情且耐用的連結。
本公司主要辦公室位於德州奧斯汀。除非上下文另有明確要求，否則 herein 所提及的 "YETI"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們"與 "我們的" 均指 YETI Holdings, Inc. 及其合併子公司。
我們的會計年度為52週或53週，於接近12月31日的星期六結束，因此每季為13週，除非是53週年度，則第四季為14週。我們2025年度會計年度（即2025年）為53週，而2024年度會計年度（即2024年）與2023年度會計年度（即2023年）則為52週。除非另有說明，否則提及特定年份、季度、月份與期間均指會計年度於12月結束，以及該會計年度的相關季度、月份與期間。
我們的產品組合包含三個類別：保冷箱與設備；飲料容器；及其他。我們有持續擴展高表現、高價位產品組合的歷史，以符合我們不斷擴大的客戶羣及其演變的活動需求。我們創新文化與成功識別客戶需求與願望的經驗，驅動我們強大的產品發展路線圖。2025年，保冷箱與設備、飲料容器及其他類別的淨銷售額分別佔淨銷售額的40%、58%與2%。有關各產品類別的淨銷售額，請參閱財務會計憑證附註第3項。
我們的保冷箱與設備類別包含七種產品平台：硬質保冷箱、軟質保冷袋、日常揹包、旅行揹包、活動揹包、貨物與儲存設備，以及戶外生活用品。

硬質保冷箱。我們的硬質保冷箱採用無縫旋轉模製造或注射成型製造，使其幾乎無法摧毀。為達到優異的保冷效果，我們在箱體與蓋子內壁壓力注入最多兩英寸的商用級聚氨酯泡沫，並使用高階冷凍密封條以密封蓋子。2025年，我們在Roadie保冷箱系列中推出了重新設計的Roadie 24。我們的硬質保冷箱平台包括YETI Tundra、YETI Roadie、YETI V Series硬質保冷箱、YETI TANK冰桶以及YETI Silo 6G水冷機。相關配件包括鎖具、乾燥籃、飲料架與隔板。

軟質保冷袋。我們的軟質保冷袋平台包含Hopper系列與Daytrip系列軟質保冷袋。Hopper系列為我們設計的軟質保冷袋，具備防漏功能，並提供優於普通軟質保冷袋的耐用性與保冷效果。Hopper系列包括M15軟質保冷袋、M12軟質揹包保冷袋、M30軟質保冷袋、M20揹包保冷袋以及Flip軟質保冷袋。Daytrip系列為全天候使用設計，包含極具便攜性的絕緣軟質保冷袋。2025年，我們在Daytrip系列中推出Lunchboxes兩種尺寸、Lunch Bag與Tote Bag。
包袋。本公司包袋產品涵蓋三個平台，分別為日常使用、旅行及追求活動用包袋。這些產品包括Panga系列防水背囊與雙肩包、Crossroads系列雙肩包、背囊、行李箱與打包立方體、Camino Carryall以及SideKick Dry裝備盒。2025年，本公司擴充包袋產品線，推出全新Cayo系列全天候雙肩包，包含三種尺寸，以及Ranchero系列雙肩包，包含四種尺寸。
貨運與儲存。本公司提供多種貨運與儲存解決方案，包括LoadOut GoBox多種尺寸、LoadOut Bucket以及LoadOut Swivel Seat。2025年，本公司也擴充貨運產品線，推出較小尺寸的LoadOut GoBox。
戶外生活。本公司戶外生活平台包括Trailhead露營椅、Lowlands毯子以及Boomer狗食盆。2025年，本公司也擴充戶外生活產品線，推出全新Hondo海灘椅、限量發行的Can Crusher以及YETI火坑。
本公司飲料容器類別包含四個平台：水瓶與壺、杯子、馬克杯與保溫杯、餐具、咖啡器具、酒吧器具與容器，以及炊具。本公司大多數飲料容器產品均採用耐用、廚房級18/8不鏽鋼、雙層真空絕熱設計，以及創新無滴水設計。結果是高表現的飲料容器產品，可讓飲料維持在理想溫度—無論熱或冷—長時間不結露。
水瓶與壺。本公司水瓶與壺平台包括Rambler系列水瓶與壺、Yonder系列水瓶與搖晃瓶，以及Silo系列壺。2025年，本公司擴充此平台，推出Rambler Travel Bottle三種尺寸、Yonder Shaker Bottle兩種尺寸、Silo Jug附吸管蓋兩種尺寸、Silo Jug附吸管蓋，並推出重新設計的Rambler Jug兩種尺寸。
杯子、馬克杯與保溫杯。本公司杯子、馬克杯與保溫杯平台包括Rambler系列可堆疊品脫、馬克杯、保溫杯與杯子。2025年，本公司擴充此平台，推出Rambler Travel Straw Mug三種尺寸以及Rambler Junior Tumbler附硅膠吸管。

paragraphs: 總部設於德州奧斯汀的 YETI，是一家全球知名的創新戶外產品設計、零售商與經銷商。從保冷箱與飲料容器到包袋與服飾，YETI 產品皆為滿足多樣化的戶外活動需求而設計，無論是在偏遠的野外、海灘，或任何生活場景。透過持續提供高性能且卓越的產品，我們在全球建立了堅實的品牌忠誠粉絲羣，從專業戶外愛好者到僅僅重視產品品質與設計的消費者。我們對戶外與休閒社羣有堅定的承諾，並持續追求打造更優質的產品，讓消費者能安心享受戶外與超越戶外的生活。

我們透過平衡的全通路平台來銷售產品，包含我們的經銷渠道與直接對消費者（"DTC"）渠道。在經銷渠道，我們透過選擇性的全國與區域性經銷商，以及美國、加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、英國、歐洲與日本等地的獨立零售夥伴來銷售產品。我們謹慎評估並選擇零售夥伴，確保其形象與經營方式與我們的高價位品牌相符。美國的全國與區域性專業零售業者包括 Dick's Sporting Goods、REI、Academy Sports + Outdoors、Bass Pro Shops、Ace Hardware、Scheels 與 Tractor Supply Company。在國際市場，我們的知名零售業者包括加拿大 FGL Sports 與 SportChek、澳洲 BCF 與 Rebel、以及英國 GO Outdoors。我們透過網站、YETI Authorized 在 Amazon 市場平台，以及零售門市銷售產品至 DTC 渠道。此外，我們透過企業銷售方案，於網站、特定零售門市以及部分經銷商，提供客製化產品，包含授權標誌與原創圖案。企業銷售方案為企業客戶提供客製化產品，用於各種活動與場合，有時也會提供產品供重新銷售。
在 2025 年第一季，我們擴充了包袋產品線，推出新 Ranchero 揹包兩種尺寸，並在 Drinkware 與 Coolers & Equipment 分類中推出新的季節色彩系列。

在 2025 年第二季，我們擴充了水瓶與水桶產品線，推出新 Rambler Travel Bottle 兩種尺寸，並推出重新設計與改進的 Rambler Jug 兩種尺寸。我們持續擴充餐桌用品產品線，推出新 Rambler Insulated Bowls 六種尺寸，並擴充炊具產品線，推出新尺寸的 Cast Iron Skillet。在 Coolers & Equipment 分類中，我們擴充硬質保冷箱產品線，推出重新設計的 Roadie 24，並擴充戶外生活產品線，推出新 Hondo Beach Chair 與限量版 Can Crusher。我們持續擴充包袋產品線，推出新 Cayo 揹包兩種尺寸與新 Ranchero 揹包兩種尺寸。在軟質保冷箱包袋產品線中，我們擴充 Daytrip 系列，推出新 Daytrip Lunchboxes 兩種尺寸、Daytrip Lunch Bag 與 Daytrip Tote Bag。我們也於 Drinkware 與 Coolers & Equipment 分類中推出新的季節色彩系列。

在 2025 年第三季，我們擴充咖啡用品產品線，推出 Rambler Ceramic Mug Collection 兩種尺寸，並在水瓶產品線中推出新尺寸的 Rambler Travel Bottle。我們持續擴充容器產品線，推出新 Rambler Food Jars 兩種尺寸。在 Coolers & Equipment 分類中，我們擴充包袋產品線，推出新尺寸的 Cayo 揹包。我們也於 Drinkware 與 Coolers & Equipment 分類中推出新的季節色彩系列。

在 2025 年第四季，我們擴充水瓶與水桶產品線，推出 Yonder Shaker Bottle 兩種尺寸、Silo Jug with Straw Cap 兩種尺寸與 Silo Jug with Chug Cap。我們持續擴充咖啡杯與保溫杯產品線，推出 Rambler Travel Straw Mug 三種尺寸、Rambler Junior Tumbler with Silicone Straw，並在咖啡用品產品線中推出新尺寸的 Rambler Ceramic Stackable Cup。我們也於容器產品線中推出新尺寸的 Rambler Food Jar。我們持續擴充炊具產品線，推出新 Cast Iron Ranch Pan 與限量版新 Carbon Steel Pan。在 Coolers & Equipment 分類中，我們擴充戶外生活與貨運產品線，推出 YETI Fire Pit 與較小尺寸的 LoadOut GoBox。
在 2025 年第三季，我們以 3800 萬美元現金（"Helimix 收購"）取得與 Helimix 品牌搖晃瓶相關的設計、模具與智慧財產權。在 2025 年第四季，我們展示我們的市場快速反應能力，推出 Yonder Shaker Bottle，進一步拓展 YETI 在運動、健康與 wellness 分類的業務。此產品發佈部分歸功於 Helimix 收購。
我們的業務受到總體經濟因素的影響，包括但不限於通貨膨脹壓力的不確定性、消費者信心與購買新趨勢、外幣匯率波動、地緣政治衝突，以及政府行動與政策，包括利率、稅率與關稅的變動。我們在 2025 年經歷了困難的總體經濟與消費者支出環境，對我們的營運結果造成負面影響。2026 年我們受此環境的影響程度仍不確定。

2025 年，美國政府對來自多個國家的進口商品實施了累進性關稅。我們大多數產品是在受這些關稅影響的國家生產的。因此，將我們的產品進口至美國的成本增加。2025 年，我們採取了多項戰略選項以緩解關稅的影響。例如，針對 2025 年初宣佈的對中國進口商品提高的關稅，我們加速將 Drinkware 的製造多元化至中國以外的國家。因此，我們 Drinkware 的製造能力現在大多數已經位於中國以外。然而，這些加速多元化的努力導致 2025 年短期的供應鏈中斷，影響我們取得某些產品的能力。這些中斷造成存貨限制，對 2025 年的銷售產生負面影響。

2026 年 2 月 20 日，美國最高法院廢除了根據國際緊急經濟權力法（the "IEEPA Decision"）所課徵的關稅。關於 IEEPA 決議的實施，仍存在顯著的不確定性，包括退款聲請的程序、任何潛在退款的時間點，以及我們最終可能恢復的金額（如有）。此外，在 IEEPA 決議後，美國政府根據其他權限啟動了新的關稅，導致我們許多產品持續面臨關稅風險。關於這些新啟動關稅的持續時間與範圍，美國政府是否會採取進一步貿易行動或課徵更多關稅，以及這些條件對我們業務的影響，仍存在顯著的不確定性。與我們 2025 年的策略類似，我們將努力透過管理營運費用、營運資金與現金；與供應商協商；評估價格策略；在可能的情況下利用關稅豁免；以及進行其他供應鏈優化活動，來緩解關稅的影響。然而，關稅對我們 2026 年業務與營運成果的最終影響仍不確定。

headings: 與本公司業務、營運及產業相關之風險
若我們無法成功設計、開發並行銷新產品，本公司業務可能受到損害。
若我們無法準確預測成長率及產品需求，本公司業務可能受到重大損害。
我們可能無法有效管理成長。
本公司成長部分取決於擴展至更多消費市場，我們可能無法成功進行。
本公司未來之成功取決於管理階層及關鍵員工持續努力，以及本公司吸引並留住高技能人才及高階管理人才之能力。
若我們侵犯第三方之智慧財產權，我們可能面臨責任。
我們依賴第三方製造商，若供應商出現問題或失去供應商，或無法取得原物料，可能損害本公司業務及營運成果。
若本公司未能及時且有效地從製造商取得產品並交付給零售夥伴及客戶，將可能對本公司業務及營運成果造成損害。
本公司業務面臨製造商集中度的風險。
若本公司未能執行擴展供應鏈、技術及某些其他業務流程至廣泛全球規模的計畫，將可能對本公司業務造成損害。
若本公司無法維持價格或有效實施價格上漲，毛利率可能下降。
原材料、設備、人力及運輸成本與可得性的波動，可能導致製造延遲或增加本公司成本。
國際貿易政策、關稅及條約的不利變動，包括關稅率提高及額外關稅的實施，可能對本公司業務及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司在永續發展事項上的願景、揭露及行動，使本公司面臨可能損害聲譽與表現的風險。
氣候變遷，以及相關的立法與監管對氣候變遷的回應，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
若我們無法成功應對與DTC通路相關的風險，或無法在該通路上獲得足夠的投資回報，將可能對本公司業務及營運成果造成損害。
若我們的零售合作夥伴遭遇財務困難、信用問題或其他財務問題，將可能使本公司面臨財務風險。
若我們的獨立供應商及製造合作夥伴未能遵守商業倫理規範或適用的法律法規，將可能對本公司聲譽、業務及營運成果造成損害。
本公司面臨與付款相關的風險，可能導致營運成本增加或無法處理付款，任一情況均可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成損害。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能受多項風險與不確定因素影響，無論是否為現有或未知，任何一項或數項皆可能直接或間接導致本公司實際營運成果與財務狀況與過去或預期未來之營運成果與財務狀況有重大差異。下列討論之風險並非本公司所面臨之唯一風險，但確實為本公司認為對本公司而言屬重要之風險。尚有其他風險與不確定因素，目前本公司尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，亦可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司之業務依賴於維持與強化品牌以吸引新客戶，並產生與維持對產品之持續需求，若此類需求大幅減少，可能對本公司之營運成果造成損害。

YETI 名稱與高檔品牌形象對本公司業務之成長，以及本公司擴張業務之策略之實施至關重要。本公司之成功依賴於品牌之價值與聲譽，而此聲譽源自對戶外活動之熱情。為維持長期成長，本公司必須持續成功地將產品推廣至與本公司品牌價值相符之消費者，以及僅僅重視產品無妥協品質與設計之個人。本公司執行市場行銷與成長策略之能力，取決於多項因素，例如產品之品質、設計、性能、功能與耐用性；本公司電商平台之形象與聲譽；零售店面與經銷商店面之設計；本公司溝通活動之影響，包括廣告、社交媒體與公共關係；以及本公司對客戶體驗之管理，包括透過客服之直接接觸。維持、推廣與定位本公司品牌對擴大客戶羣至關重要，並將 largely 取決於本公司市場行銷與商品展示之成效，以及本公司提供一致、高品質客戶體驗之能力。

本公司已進行，並預期將持續進行重大投資以推廣產品與吸引新客戶，包括透過企業與運動聯盟合作、YETI 經紀人、傳統、數位與社交媒體、原創 YETI 影片，以及參與並贊助社區活動。市場行銷活動可能昂貴，且未必能以成本效益方式取得客戶。行銷不當、持續且持續的促銷活動、負面宣傳、產品轉向未經授權之分銷渠道、產品或製造缺陷、產品回收、仿冒產品、不當勞工實踐，以及未能保護本公司品牌之智慧財產權，是對品牌強度之潛在威脅，這些因素及其他因素可能迅速且嚴重地降低客戶對本公司之信心。此外，這些因素可能導致客戶失去對 YETI 品牌之個人連結。資訊透過社交媒體迅速傳播，也提高負面宣傳之風險，無論此宣傳是否準確，關於產品性能、經紀人行為、公司政策或來源實踐之負面宣傳，可能迅速削減品牌價值。與 YETI 有關之個人或組織（包括經紀人與影響者）之行為若與本公司品牌價值不一致，無論是在本公司平台或其平台，也可能損害本公司品牌聲譽，並對本公司業務造成重大影響。此外，現在本公司品牌在已建立市場中更為廣為人知，未來市場行銷活動可能無法以與過去活動相同之速率吸引新客戶。通貨膨脹、產品成本提高或其他總體經濟因素也可能影響本公司以成本效益方式提供產品之能力，並阻礙本公司吸引新客戶。若本公司無法吸引新客戶，或無法以成本效益方式吸引新客戶，或未能在新客戶與現有客戶中提高本公司完整產品組合之認知度，本公司之成長可能慢於預期，且本公司業務可能受損。

本公司產品之市場特徵為新產品推出、頻繁改進、客製化選項、現有產品之新色系，以及客戶需求、需求與偏好的變化。此現象尤其明顯，因本公司產品為高品質、耐用，並無自然更換週期。較短之創新週期與社交媒體評論之影響日益增加，進一步提高新產品未能達到預期接受度，或本公司智慧財產權保護措施被繞過之風險。為維持與提高銷售，本公司必須持續於適時推出新產品，並改善或提升現有產品，以回應新興與變化的消費者偏好。本公司新產品與改進產品之成功取決於多項因素，包括預測消費者偏好、尋找創新解決消費者問題之方案、與競爭對手產品區隔、維持品牌強度、上線新製造流程與供應商，以及成功之產品生命週期管理。本公司產品之設計與開發成本高昂，且本公司通常同時進行多項產品之開發。設計或品質問題，或新產品發佈之延誤，可能損害品牌、幹擾業務，並對財務狀況與營運成果造成負面影響。本公司所開發與行銷之任何新產品，可能無法產生足夠收入以彌補其開發、生產、行銷、銷售及其他成本。

為確保足夠之存貨供應，本公司必須預測存貨需求，並在客戶下正式訂單前與製造商下訂單。預測尤其困難，因本公司擴張至新市場與地理區域，開發與行銷新產品，並面臨總體經濟不確定性，包括與消費者可支配支出、利率、通貨膨脹、關稅與地緣政治事件相關之因素。本公司歷史銷售、費用水平與獲利能力，可能不適合作為預測未來結果之基礎。若本公司未能準確預測客戶需求，包括與預期成長相關之需求，本公司可能遭遇過多存貨或無法交付產品至客戶之情況。未能準確預測營運成果與成長率，也可能導致本公司做出錯誤之營運決策，且本公司可能無法及時調整。因此，實際結果可能與預期有重大落差。即使本公司所競爭之市場擴張，本公司無法保證本公司業務將以相似速率成長，或以任何速率成長。
